sloka: हताश्वाद्वेगवान् वेगादवप्लुत्य महारथात् ।क्रोधमाहारयत्तीव्रं भ्रातरं प्रति रावणः ।। ६.१०१.१८ ।।
transliteration: hatāśvādvegavān vegādavaplutya mahārathāt ।krodhamāhārayattīvraṁ bhrātaraṁ prati rāvaṇaḥ ।। 6.101.18 ।।

translations.english: With the horses of his chariot dead, Ravana descended from the huge chariot and exhibited violent rage against his brother.
